title: Section 14A
content: 1[14A. Power of Authority to collect policy information.---The Authority may, for the purpose of efficient discharge of its functions and to regulate and develop the insurance business--- (a) collect in such manner as it may think fit, information relating to policies and claims from any insurer or other regulated entities; and (b) furnish such information to any insurer or other regulated entities in accordance with the provisions of section 14C.]
